model-value.desc: Current panel name; use v-model (synced with QTabs model)

keep-alive.desc: Equivalent to Vue's native <keep-alive> on the content

swipeable.desc: Enable swipe gestures to switch panels

vertical.desc: Transitions and swipe on the vertical axis

transition-prev.desc: Transition when going to previous panel (requires 'animated')

transition-next.desc: Transition when going to next panel (requires 'animated')

dark.desc: Notify the component that the background is a dark color

update:model-value.desc: Emitted when the active panel changes

before-transition.desc: Emitted before transitioning to a new panel

transition.desc: Emitted after transitioning to a new panel
